name: Mugatu So Hot Right Now
look: A still from Zoolander. Will Ferrell as Mugatu, with frizzy blond curls and a goatee, sits in an audience holding a white poodle and speaking, wearing a fringed western-style outfit with red trim. Milla Jovovich sits beside him in red, scowling.
use: Declares something trendy or suddenly popular. Following Mugatu's line, the top caption names the hot new thing and the bottom says 'so hot right now,' often sarcastically about something mundane.
slots: bottom caption: usually 'so hot right now'
